rules.title: Prohibition on algorithmic devices to set rents (Rent Ordinance Section 37.10C)
rules.requirement: Prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco. An algorithmic device is a device such as a software program that uses algorithms to analyze nonpublic competitor rental data to recommend to a landlord what rent to charge for a vacant unit.
rules.coverage_text: Sale or use of algorithmic devices (such as software programs that analyze nonpublic competitor rental data to recommend rents for vacant units) for residential units in San Francisco.
rules.penalty: A tenant or the City Attorney may bring a civil action against an entity believed to be in violation of the law.
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
